sections.title: Built in Limerick, answered like a local
sections.dek: Not a call centre in another timezone. CallMeIE is operated from Dooradoyle, runs on a real Limerick 061 line, and is tuned for the way Limerick and Munster callers actually speak.
sections.body: A customer ringing a Castletroy salon, a Raheen garage, or a city-centre solicitor expects the phone to be answered — and when it rings out at lunchtime or after six, most of them don't leave a voicemail. They ring the next business on the Google list. CallMeIE closes that gap: the line is covered every hour of every day, the voice is a natural Irish accent rather than a generic American one, and the system is set up so a caller from Limerick, Clare or Tipperary is never asked to repeat themselves or pushed into a press-one menu. It's operated in-house from Dooradoyle, on the same 061 number your callers already trust — no offshore call centre, no caller data sold on.

sections.title: What it handles for a Limerick business
sections.dek: Six jobs, one system, working the hours a human front desk can't. Not a generic chatbot — a receptionist that happens to be software.
sections.body:
I — Answer

Answers every call, 24/7

Lunchtime, after six, weekends, bank holidays — the phone is covered. Callers get a real conversation, not a voicemail beep, so they book instead of ringing a competitor.

II — Book

Books into your diary

Reads your Google Calendar live, quotes a real slot, and confirms the appointment — no double-booking, no "we'll call you back".

III — Text back

Missed-call text-back (60s)

Any call that still rings out gets an SMS within a minute offering to book or answer a quick question. No Limerick lead goes cold.

IV — Qualify

Takes the details that matter

Name, number, reason for the call, urgency — captured every time and waiting for you, instead of a half-remembered note on the counter.

V — Escalate

Forwards the urgent ones

Genuinely urgent calls route straight to your mobile, with an SMS summary at the same time. You decide the rules at onboarding.

VI — Report

Monday morning summary

A plain email each Monday: calls taken, appointments booked, missed-call recoveries, and the most common questions this week. Read in ninety seconds.

sections.title: Built for Ireland, not for "UK & Ireland"
sections.dek: The specifics that come up on a real Limerick call. Generic global-AI receptionists fail on every line in this list.
sections.body:
• Munster accentsTuned and tested against real Irish caller recordings. A strong Limerick or Clare accent is not routed to "press 9 for English".
  • 061 & mobile formatsHandles 061 landlines and 085/086/087/089 mobiles interchangeably — no rejected numbers.
  • Bank holidaysSt Patrick's Day, Easter Monday, the May/June/August bank holidays, October, Christmas and St Stephen's Day — auto-respects your closure calendar.

  • Keep your numberWe sit behind your existing 061 line via call forwarding — your customers ring the number already on your van, card and Google listing.
